svg.title: Questlock human outcome feedback
svg.desc: Unreleased v0.4.0 candidate. Opted-in worker attempts record content-free metadata in existing scoped broker artifacts. Explicit human feedback can accept, rewrite, reject, or reopen work. Rewrites clear acceptance until explicit reacceptance. A cohort report includes all recorded attempts and explicit reviewer effort; unknown accounting remains unknown. Langfuse check scores remain separate from human acceptance.

g.text: Questlock human outcome feedback
v0.4.0 candidate · explicit review after declared checks
Worker invocation
Opt in: track_outcome = true
Checks, usage, output digest, run ID
Fresh attempts and zero-generation reuse
Optional Langfuse copy
Current generation metadata + check scores
Checks do not establish human acceptance
Human feedback is not exported here
Scoped outcome record · broker + SQLite
Existing versioned artifacts; no schema migration
Run receipts + event IDs + expected versions
No prompts, answers, or final artifact contents
Explicit human feedback
Accepted · rewritten · rejected · reopened
Rewrite reason + effort; any rewrite clears acceptance
Reaccept with a final artifact SHA-256
Declared cohort report
All recorded attempt estimates + recorded effort
Divide by currently human-accepted outcomes
Missing cost, effort, or rate remains visible
All recorded cohort attempts count, including failed and rejected work.
Unknown cost or effort stays unknown. Zero accepted outcomes has no unit cost.
Scoped metadata only; no passive edit watching, model training, or invoice reconciliation.
